aiReview.method: Direct Japanese-to-Simplified-Chinese translation and semantic comparison of every source paragraph, all lesson metadata, prompts, options, option-specific reasons and all effective source readingJa fields. Repeated Japanese reference definitions reuse the same Chinese definition without being counted as additional unique knowledge.
aiReview.register: Respectful adult 您 to service users; natural colleagues; original Japanese character names retained; no inferred age, gender, kinship, diagnosis or unsupported promise. Japanese headwords/kana retained for learning with Chinese definitions.
specificChecks: Right shoulder vs left knee; morning vs noon; report source vs measured facts.
10:00 seated observation does not imply all-afternoon posture or ability; pain unasked remains unconfirmed.
Right/left ear, direction reference facing reception, location-only request vs permission to touch or guide.
Dementia diagnosis belongs only to the stipulated scene; anxiety empathy does not confirm an appointment or theft.
11:10 water observation vs source unknown, no injury report vs all-person confirmation, cleaning message vs safe reopening.
13:00 tiredness, activity refusal, nurse contact vs assessment completion.

08:20 worker-back-pain scenario kept separate from 09:15/09:20 follow-up; worker fatigue vs resident whole-body fatigue; pain unasked then self-reported no pain; nurse contacted but not arrived; role change pending.
Source numeric values, medical boundaries, device/training/individual-plan requirements and emergency-reporting priority preserved.
Effective question readings translated exactly as present, including the question-specific added location and injury-report facts. No answer-action sentences introduced.

limits: AI translation/editorial comparison only. No independent human, native-speaker, domain, rights or release approval.
No source-book coverage percentage or unique-concept coverage is claimed from repeated paragraph records.
No other locale used as source or pivot. Existing zh-CN style profile used for consistency.
No actual app integration, UI change, device/rendering approval, new image, clinical validation or commit by this translator.
